attchmntText: PPAP Automotive Limited has informed the Exchange about Presentation and Link of Recording
voiceSummary: PPAP Automotive Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The call was held on 11th November 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://www.ppapco.in/financials#conference_call_recording. The presentation shared with participants was previously intimated to stock exchanges via a wide letter dated 7th November 2026. This presentation is also uploaded on the company website. The filing is made pursuant to regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: PPAP Automotive Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: PPAP Automotive Limited published unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 6th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, consolidated revenue from operations was 17,782.66 lakhs. Consolidated net profit after tax and exceptional items was 247.39 lakhs. Earnings per share was 1.75. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs. 1.5 per equity share. The record date is 13th November 2026. Jana Capital Limited also filed its quarterly results. Jana Capital reported total income from operations of 27,041.81 thousands for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a net loss after tax of 2.43 thousands.

attchmntText: PPAP Automotive Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "Media release for unaudited financial result for quarter and half year ended 30 September, 2026".
voiceSummary: PPAP Automotive Limited filed a media release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations grew by 29.8% year on year to INR 177.8 crore in the second quarter and by 31.8% to INR 334.2 crore in the half year. EBITDA increased to INR 15.7 crore in the quarter and INR 28.1 crore in the half year. The company reported a consolidated profit after tax of INR 2.5 crore for the quarter and INR 3.3 crore for the half year. Order wins totaled approximately INR 429 crore in the half year, with EV-related orders reaching INR 157 crore. The Board of Directors has declared an interim dividend of INR 1.50 per equity share.

attchmntText: PPAP Automotive Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: PPAP Automotive Limited filed an Analysts and Investors presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2FY27 grew by 29.8% year-on-year to 177.8 crore rupees. Half year consolidated revenue increased by 31.8% to 334.2 crore rupees. Profit after tax for Q2FY27 was 3.5 crore rupees, up from 0.05 crore rupees in the prior year. Half year profit after tax was 3.3 crore rupees compared to a loss of 2.3 crore rupees previously. The Board declared an interim dividend of 1.50 rupees per equity share. Lifetime order wins totaled approximately 429 crore rupees in the first half of FY27. This included 157 crore rupees from electric vehicle segments.
